mechanicalContract.packingScope: External opposed pairs only; excludes sensor cell and all frame/guide/driver dimensions. No purchased parts or structural prototype qualification.

upperObserver.contract: Causal four-state ZOH observer. No plant A/current/actuator-force/surface truth. Issued current has a strictly proper identified lag and the existing ADC frame; estimated guide friction is delayed one control tick. Actual and identified mechanics match in development.

developmentContract: Eight mass/force/orientation corners plus three interiors; 2s sharp bump at1s, zero robot axial motion/offset, known actual/identified mechanics. Gains are bounded choices selected only on development. Same991000+case noise seeds across gains/designs. No learned policy tuning or fresh qualification.
